title: An Idea Becomes a System

scenes.title: Curtain up on the idea
scenes.purpose: On a frontal, axially symmetric night stage, one idea (the lamp) lights up and links to mirrored nodes and a ledger, so it reads as a connected system.
visuals: Fixed proscenium: oxblood scalloped valance with gold trim and a centre medallion, plus slate side pillars
Mirrored oxblood velvet curtains that part to gold tie-backs
Deep teal-black back wall with concentric slate arches converging on the centre axis
Reflective dark floor with seams converging on the vanishing point and faint mirrored reflections
Centre plinth lamp whose terracotta globe warms to amber, with a cream filament
Four mirrored pedestals carrying sage and cream nodes, joined to the lamp by amber dashed links
Ledger plate on the plinth front with cream rules
Lettering: ACT ONE, An Idea Becomes a System, and the caption THE LAMP · THE LINKS · THE LEDGER

beats.development: The curtains part symmetrically from closed to their gathered tie-backs while the inner set begins a slow push-in along the centre axis. The lamp plinth rises from the stage trap from 0.5s.
captions: THE LAMP · THE LINKS · THE LEDGER

beats.development: The filament draws on and the globe warms to amber, lighting the inner arches and the floor reflection. The mirrored pedestals rise, the amber dashed links draw outward, the nodes light from inner to outer, and the ledger rules are written in. The title words slide inward to their final spacing and a gold rule draws out from the centre.
captions: THE LAMP · THE LINKS · THE LEDGER

beats.development: The complete symmetric tableau holds still so it can be read.
captions: THE LAMP · THE LINKS · THE LEDGER

findings: All motion settles by 2.5s, which leaves a 0.5s hold of the complete readable scene before 3s.
The copy is readable from the first frame; only the title's word positions settle, by transform.
justifiedHolds: 2.5-3.0s: final read of the settled tableau

notes: Silent preview with no audio track.
